# clio admit

score one write without storing it; `--file ops.json` previews a whole batch instead

## Usage

```
clio admit TEXT --category C [--bank BANK] [--actor ACTOR] [--epistemic-kind fact|belief] [--confidence N] [--source-type T] [--evidence-ref E] [--context TEXT] [--output json|text]
clio admit --file ops.json [--bank BANK] [--actor ACTOR]
```

## Description

--context records where the memory came from, such as a conversation type or workflow stage; it is not searchable and recall does not match on it, so put anything you want to find later in TEXT. It is at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes, rejected when empty or oversized, never truncated

--epistemic-kind and --source-type are a pair: --source-type (user_stated|agent_inferred|third_party) is required with belief and must be omitted with fact

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `TEXT` | yes | The memory text that becomes the item's gist: `remember` stores it, and `admit` only scores it. |

## Options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--category C` | enum: task_spec, schema, tool_config, output_constraint, persona |  | Names the semantic category (`task_spec`, `schema`, `tool_config`, `output_constraint`, `persona`); `cli_write_core` validates it. |
| `--bank BANK` | text |  | Scopes the command to one bank; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and the write scope defaults to `default`. |
| `--actor ACTOR` | text |  | Names the acting identity; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and `auth_cli` reads it for the actor commands. |
| `--epistemic-kind fact\|belief` | enum: fact, belief | `fact` | Marks `fact` or `belief`; `cli_write_core` defaults to `fact`. |
| `--confidence N` | float |  | `parse_unit_f64` bounds the value. |
| `--source-type T` | enum: user_stated, agent_inferred, third_party |  | Names belief provenance (`user_stated`, `agent_inferred`, `third_party`); required with belief. |
| `--evidence-ref E` | text |  | `cli_write_core` forwards evidence. |
| `--context TEXT` | text |  | `context_arg` bounds and rejects it. |
| `--file ops.json` | text |  | `admit` previews the batch. |
| `--output json\|text` | enum: json, text |  | Selects the output mode that `cli_output::resolve_output` returns; the terminal decides it when absent. |

## Global options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--db PATH` | text |  | Overrides the store address that `db_target::resolve_target` opens; config and environment decide it when absent. |
| `--backend sqlite\|postgres` | enum: sqlite, postgres |  | Selects the store backend that `db_target::resolve_target` hands to the resolver; config or the address decides it when absent. |
| `--no-input` |  |  | Refuses interactive input; `backup_restore_cli` treats a run with it as non-interactive. |
| `--yes` |  |  | Answers yes to the destructive-confirmation gate that `cli_confirm::confirmed` applies. |

## Examples

```
clio admit "Bob lives in Canada" --category persona
```

belief carries its source type
```
clio admit "Prefers tea" --category persona --epistemic-kind belief --source-type user_stated
```

```
clio admit "Bob lives in Canada" --category persona -o json
```
